deferredIssues.title: Rapid navigation during the existing screen transition can be ignored
deferredIssues.evidence: Contact Escape removes the page after 760ms, but triggerScreenTransition retains its lock until 1680ms. Opening the menu and immediately choosing About during that remaining interval closed the menu without changing pages. Later checks wait for .wt-case-transition to detach.
